summary: Relocate skill sources of truth from root skills/ into the component repos whose contracts they describe; root skills/ becomes a link farm.
Register Momo and Toad as components, bringing the active registry to thirteen; declare runtime mode and execution model for non-service components.
Declare Krebs the single ticket-lifecycle authority (FR12) and open a backfill for the drifted pre-promotion copy still carried in momo/lifecycle/.
Fold all in-flight work to main, advance every submodule pin to its origin/main tip, and prune six worktrees whose branches were merged or proven superseded by content comparison.
